author: Anonymous
title: Take your time
pull: Be patient, take things one step at a time, and don’t take yourself or the moment too seriously. Think about the long-term, but don’t forget to be present.
paras: These next several years will feel like a blur when they’re over. The past 4 years have flown by and moved at a snail’s pace. I’ve cycled through life plans and day plans, each of them seeming at one point like they must happen and at another moment like they’re impossible.

Take your time, collect yourself, and recognize that you cannot and will not find a solution to all of the questions and issues you face in one fell-swoop. Be patient, take things one step at a time, and don’t take yourself or the moment too seriously. Think about the long-term, but don’t forget to be present. ♡

author: Em
title: It’s not that deep
pull: Trust the universe and everything will work out the way that you want it to. The universe rewards good energy.
paras: Whatever you are worried about, it’s not that deep. Fuck it, have experiences, go follow your heart. Do what you want. Trust the universe and everything will work out the way that you want it to.
The universe rewards good energy. You will receive whatever you put out into it.
